messages:
alice.ops: heads up — customer `Velora Inc.` reports two invoices for the same subscription period after the auto-renewal ran. They paid via PO and then the card retried, looks like both cleared. :grimacing:
ben.billing: tx ids? can you paste the payment ids and invoice numbers?
alice.ops: invoice INV-2026-0457 (PO: PO-9987) and invoice INV-2026-0458 (card). Payment IDs: `pay_0x9a1` (PO/ACH/AR) and `pay_0x9a2` (card_charge). Both settled according to gateway.
carol-support: ugh, customer says their ERP accepted both. They're asking for one reversal + credit note to avoid double-recognition.
dave-finance: do we have a webhook duplication or double-capture? show the webhook delivery for the renewal event.
alice.ops: here's the renewal webhook payload (sanitized):
```
{"event":"subscription.renewal","subscription_id":"sub_57ab","invoice":"INV-2026-0457","amount":49900,"payment_method":"po","metadata":{"po":"PO-9987","external_reference":"velora-erp-123"}}
{"event":"subscription.renewal","subscription_id":"sub_57ab","invoice":"INV-2026-0458","amount":49900,"payment_method":"card","metadata":{"card_last4":"4242","external_reference":"velora-erp-123"}}
```
ben.billing: looks like two separate renewal events queued — why would the scheduler emit twice? check retries + idempotency.
carol-support: customer notes they updated payment method right at renewal time; maybe both payments authorized: PO clear -> then card expired and retried but gateway accepted a minute later.
dave-finance: for refunds: we can credit the PO invoice (INV-2026-0457) to match their accounting practices since PO was primary. We'll need to reverse `pay_0x9a2` (card) if they prefer. Which one do they want reversed?
alice.ops: I asked them: they want the card charge reversed and a credit note issued for the PO so their AR remains consistent. They also flagged VAT mismatch: PO invoice had VAT 0% but card invoice had VAT 20% — that created discrepant totals.
ben.billing: VAT mismatch is interesting — our tax calc should be deterministic by subscription config. Did the second invoice pick up a different tax_profile? search the invoice objects.
alice.ops: digging — INV-2026-0457.tax_profile = "standard-uk-0"; INV-2026-0458.tax_profile = "standard-uk-20". Both linked to same subscription.
dave-finance: that suggests a race during tax-profile lookup at renewal time. Maybe subscription had a temporary override while payment method change was in-flight. We'll flag for eng but fix customer first.
carol-support: next steps for customer: 1) initiate refund for `pay_0x9a2` (card) 2) create credit note for INV-2026-0458 to zero it out (or for the PO one per their AR). They asked for a single credit note referencing both invoices. Is that allowed?
ben.billing: we can issue a single credit note referencing multiple invoices, but better to do refund + credit note for audit. I can prepare the credit note draft.
dave-finance: please include explanation re: VAT inconsistent rounding and reference both payment ids. I'll sign off.
alice.ops: billing-bot, kick off refund flow for `pay_0x9a2` and create credit note CN-2026-007 referencing INV-2026-0458 with reason "Duplicate charge on renewal; PO retained".
billing-bot: Refund queued for `pay_0x9a2` — gateway refund id `rf_5b8` created. Credit note CN-2026-007 drafted (status: pending_approval).
carol-support: sent message to Velora with expected timeline: refund shows in 3–7 business days, credit note PDF attached once approved.
alice.ops: for engineering follow-up: tagging eng-runtime — suspected idempotency/tax profile race when payment method changed during renewal window. Created ticket RNFW-1721.
ben.billing: quick note: log lines near the dup events show renewal job retried at t+8s with different context. adding snippet to ticket.
dave-finance: approving CN-2026-007 now. please confirm once refund settles and mark thread resolved.
carol-support: :white_check_mark: will follow up with customer after settlement.
alice.ops: resolving here — created refund + credit note, finance approved. moving to postmortem in RNFW-1721.
carol-support: thanks team. :pray:
